messages.subject: legend affected by geom_text
parts:
I am doing a time series plot and then using geom_text to add a label
with the value of the last point in each series. Without geom_text
the legend shows me the color and linetype and shape of the lines.
When I addthe geom_text, it creates a legend that has a filled square
for the color of each group. It seems to over-write the appearance of
the point shape and linetype for the groups (which means the plot is
less useful if it's photocopied in B&W).

Here's a crude example to illustrate the issue:
# create sample data frame q (inelegantly)
xgroup<-data.frame(c("one","two","three"))
names(xgroup)<-c("set")
ygroup<-data.frame(c("A", "B", "C"))
names(ygroup)<-c("unit")
zgroup<-data.frame(as.integer(2006:2008))
names(zgroup)<-c("year")
q<-merge(xgroup,merge(ygroup,zgroup))
q$y <- as.integer(q$set)*300 + ((as.integer(q$year)-2000)
*100)+as.integer(q$unit)*700
q$stuff <- as.character(q$y)
q$partial <- q$stuff
q$partial[q$year!=2008] <- "" # blank the label unless it is the last
year

plota <- qplot(year, y, data = q, label=partial, geom=c
("point","line"), colour=unit,
main="Sample Chart Using Linetype and Shape")
plotb <- plota +facet_wrap( ~ set)
plotc <- plotb + geom_text()

alta <- qplot(year, y, data = q, label=partial, geom=c("text"),
colour=unit,
main="Sample Chart Using Linetype and Shape")
altb <- alta + facet_wrap( ~ set)
altc <- altb + geom_point(aes(data = q, y=y, x=year, colour=unit))
altd <- altc + geom_line(aes(data = q, y=y, x=year, colour=unit,
linetype=unit))

When I display plotb or altb I get the legend as I would like it to
appear. If I display plotc or altd the legend just shows a filled
block of color and the shape and linetype are not visible.

My question: Can I turn off the legend just for geom_text? Can I see
the linetype and the shape in the legend?

Plus a second un-related question: In plotb the main title prints out
at the top of the grey area, but the descenders of the letters (e.g.,
"p", "g", "y") that go below the base line of the text are hidden.
Either the grey area at the top of the chart is overwriting the
descenders or some sort of clipping is preventing the descenders from
appearing. I'm running on the default device in Windows XP. I don't
know whether this is intrinsically a ggplot issue or an interaction
with the windows device.

By the way, I've just spent a very intense week with ggplot2 (plus a
desperate detour into reshape) and I'm very happy with what I've been
able to accomplish. I'm glad my difficulties are so minor.

Thanks,
John

messages.subject: Re: legend affected by geom_text
parts:
Hi John,

Hadley's working on fixing the descenders issue. As for your other problem, try:

plotc <- plotb + geom_text(legend=False)

I'm not sure how to alter 'alt' to achieve the same, as the following
doesn't appear to change anything:

alte <- altd + geom_text(legend=FALSE)
